items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: He and I went to lessons together.

ctx.x: No, I don't think of him.

Lionel Ferbaud, his name is sort of pronounced in the French pronunciation. Well you find out about him when you go in. You ask him, he's going to laugh like heck when you tell him about it. He and I went to lessons together. And well, Lionel was never a little guy that think very much. In fact, I don't know if he ever learned, but he's a wonderful musician. He tried to be, and he suffered with asthma all his life. He and my little cousin Lionel, I think they used to, Lionel Curran, he didn't play music, but they…
Yeah. You used to fake a good deal more than you started.
